method: Tavily tavily_search, topic=news, date window [quarter_start-90d, quarter_start-1d], filter_by_published_date=true; 3-6 queries per quarter; items kept only if a publication date (Tavily published_date or date embedded in URL) is strictly before quarter start. date_basis records which.
